title: 第15章 剑丹迫切融传承第16章 剑丹成只欠东风
content_zh:
“人没来？”
听着厉秋雨的询问，谢清影摇了摇头，紧接着只见谢清影拿掉发髻，头发垂散下来，长发飘逸，此时看去，竟然是一个女儿身。
谢清影稍微拂了拂秀发，有点不解问道：
“厉姐姐，林玄师弟确实隐藏的很深，但是目前他缺的是时间，如今才仅仅灵武巅峰境界，境界的差距太悬殊了......”
“能参加三十六州会的那些人可都是三十六州层层选拔出来的天才！最次的实力也是元武巅峰，林玄师弟虽然能够斩杀三阶妖兽，但是也显得很吃力了，而且那些天才哪一个不都是刚入元武都直接斩杀三阶妖兽的，他们如今的对手都是四阶妖兽了。”
“还不如我去呢……”
最后那句话，谢清影虽然只是嘟囔了一下，但是厉秋雨却听的很清晰，轻笑说道：“小妮子，你的实力确实不错，但是你父亲有命令，三十六州会你不得参加，我也没办法。”
“哼......”
谢清影听到父亲俩个字，颇为俏皮的嘟嘴，哼了一声。
“可是现在没人去，那我们无极门就没代表了，到时候门派降级，可是重大损失。”
“不急，这不是还有半个月吗？听说那林玄是祝天虹的弟子，清影，你去给他施施压。”
厉秋雨俏眉微皱，说道。
谢清影知道，厉秋雨虽然是女儿身，但是控制欲很强，实力也很强，林玄的拒绝，可能是已经惹怒她了。
“厉姐姐，也许林玄师弟就喜欢山清水秀，真的不喜欢修炼呢？”
“你这小妮子，真当我不闻不问门内之事？谁不知道我们无极门内有一八年废材林玄......”
厉秋雨闻言戏谑笑了笑，道：“他的来历不简单，这八年，没到打雷闪电他必定去天雷峰顶，如此忍耐与毅力，不是一般人。”
谢清影知道厉秋雨很看重林玄，自己怕是去不成三十六州会，哼了一声，继续道：
“厉姐姐你让他去也行！但必须打赢我，否则我绝不会让！三十六州会，五年一次，每次的规矩都是最强的年轻一代作为代表，如果林玄师弟连我都打不过，去了岂不是落人笑柄？”
“好啦，依你依你。”厉秋雨淡笑道。
......

无极门，天雷峰。
林玄回到自己的洞府内，见师傅祝天虹依旧在闭关炼丹，便直接闭门，开始清点自己本次的收获。
“幽冥莲心火种，碧水青蛇皮，还有一劫剑体的药引，这次去百兽林算是收获颇丰。”
“现在一劫剑体的药引已经有了，接下来就是炼制剑丹！”
林玄看着桌子上摆满的药材喃喃自语。
突然脸上青红交替，林玄体内灵气开始紊乱，骚动，因为他把修为压制在灵武巅峰，压的有点太久了。
“糟了，快要压不住体内的灵力了，感觉马上要升级元武境界......”
体内灵气的突然暴乱，林玄立马盘腿坐了下来，运功压制着境界。大概过了几分钟后，才把体内的灵气暴动压制下来。
content_en:
"No one came?"
Listening to Li Qiuyu's inquiry, Xie Qingying shook her head. Then she saw Xie Qingying took off her bun, her hair was hanging down, and her long hair was flowing. At this time, she looked like she had the body of a girl.
Xie Qingying brushed her hair slightly and asked a little confused:
"Sister Li, Junior Brother Lin Xuan is indeed hiding very deep, but what he lacks now is time. He is only at the peak of Lingwu. The gap between levels is too huge..."
"Those who can participate in the Thirty-Six States Conference are all geniuses selected from the Thirty-Six States! The lowest level of strength is also the peak of Yuanwu. Although Junior Brother Lin Xuan can kill third-level monsters, it is still very difficult. Moreover, all of those geniuses have directly killed third-level monsters when they first entered Yuanwu. Their opponents now are all fourth-level monsters."
"It's better for me to go..."
Although Xie Qingying just muttered the last sentence, Li Qiuyu heard it very clearly and said with a chuckle: "Xiao Nizi, your strength is indeed good, but your father has an order that you are not allowed to participate in the Thirty-Six States Conference, and there is nothing I can do about it."
"Humph..."
When Xie Qingying heard the word father, she pouted rather playfully and snorted.
"But if no one goes now, then our Wuji Sect will have no representatives. When the time comes, the sect will be downgraded, which will be a huge loss."
"Don't worry, isn't there still half a month left? I heard that Lin Xuan is Zhu Tianhong's disciple, Qingying, you go and put pressure on him."
Li Qiuyu frowned slightly and said.
Xie Qingying knew that although Li Qiuyu was born as a girl, she was very controlling and powerful. Lin Xuan's refusal might have angered her.
"Sister Li, maybe Junior Brother Lin Xuan just likes beautiful scenery and doesn't really like practicing?"
"You little girl, do you really think that I don't care about the affairs within the sect? Who doesn't know that our Wuji sect has a good-for-nothing Lin Xuan for 18 years..."
Li Qiuyu smiled jokingly when he heard this and said: "His origins are not simple. In the past eight years, he would definitely go to the Tianlei Peak if there was no thunder and lightning. He is not an ordinary person with such patience and perseverance."
Xie Qingying knew that Li Qiuyu valued Lin Xuan very much, and she was afraid that she would not be able to go to the thirty-six states meeting, so she snorted and continued:
"Sister Li, you can let him go! But you have to beat me, otherwise I will never let him go! The thirty-six state meetings are held every five years. The rules of each time are that the strongest young generation will be the representative. If Junior Brother Lin Xuan can't even beat me, wouldn't it be a laughing stock if he goes?"
"Okay, it's up to you." Li Qiuyu said with a faint smile.
...
Wujimen, Tianleifeng.
Lin Xuan returned to his cave and saw that his master Zhu Tianhong was still refining elixirs in seclusion, so he closed the door and began to count his harvest.
"The Netherworld Lotus Heart Fire, the Blue Water Green Snake Skin, and the medicine guide for the One Tribulation Sword Body. This time I went to the Beast Forest and gained a lot."
"Now that the medicine for the Yijia Sword Body is available, the next step is to refine the sword elixir!"
Lin Xuan looked at the medicinal materials on the table and murmured to himself.
Suddenly his face turned green and red, and the spiritual energy in Lin Xuan's body began to become chaotic and turbulent, because he had suppressed his cultivation at the peak of spiritual martial arts for too long.
"Oops, I can't hold back the spiritual power in my body anymore. I feel like I'm about to upgrade to the Yuanwu realm..."
Lin Xuan immediately sat down cross-legged due to the sudden riot of spiritual energy in his body, using his skills to suppress his realm. It took about a few minutes before the spiritual energy riot in his body was suppressed.
